concerns.text: Phase 11 ‘Artifact Generation’ is not referenced by any Functional Requirement (FR‑001‑FR‑010) or Success Criterion (SC‑001‑SC‑005) in the spec, making it an over‑reach beyond the documented scope.
Phase 12 ‘Contract Validation’ is also absent from the spec’s FR/SC list; the spec does not require contract testing, so this task is currently unanchored to any requirement.
